tool_input.description: Probe ready() behavior of UnsynchronizedBufferedReader with StringReader

result:
Not a git repo, so no cleanliness check needed there — confirmed no probe files remain in `_tools/out` (it's wiped by `test.sh` anyway). All 22 tests in `ExtendedBufferedReaderAgentTest` pass.

Summary: created `src/test/java/org/apache/commons/csv/ExtendedBufferedReaderAgentTest.java`, a self-contained JUnit 5 test class (matching the project's existing JUnit version) covering `ExtendedBufferedReader`'s char/bulk reads, line counting across CR/LF/CRLF/EOF boundaries, `peek`, `mark`/`reset`, `close`, `readLine`, `ready`, and byte-tracking (`getBytesRead`) including multi-byte UTF-8 characters, surrogate pairs, and the unpaired-low-surrogate `CharacterCodingException` case. Written without lambdas, diamond operators, or try-with-resources, per the `--release 8` style constraint.
